description: The other half of `a-legend-symbol-wears-the-marks-stroke`: a style the mark **names**, and a value written as an expression. A mark's styles are its own type followed by whatever its `style` names — `getStyles` is `[].concat(mark.type, mark.style ?? [])` — and `getStyleConfig` walks them in that order with the last one that speaks winning. So `config.style.outlined` reaches a bar that asks for it, and the swatch is outlined the way the bar is. The width is an **expression**, which `applyMarkConfig` passes through `signalOrValueRef`, so what lands on the swatch is a signal rather than a value wrapped around an object — written as a value, Vega is handed `{"value": {"expr": …}}` and draws an outline of nothing. This is a chart of its own rather than a second row beside the other fixture because two size legends over the same field are hoisted into a single legend, and the second of them would then never be drawn.
